high.title: MediaTek Benefits from Cloud Giants' Self-Developed Chips and Strong Data Center Demand, Along with World Advanced and GUC, Entering Harvest Year
high.summary: AI data center applications show strong prospects as Google and AWS emphasize massive shipments of self-developed chips, boosting Taiwan's ASIC companies. Beyond established players World Advanced (3661) and GUC (3443) in this field, MediaTek's (2454) ASIC business is also bearing fruit. Industry observers expect all three companies to experience a harvest year. MediaTek CEO Tsai Li-hsing indicated that the first AI accelerator ASIC project for a major U.S. cloud service provider is progressing smoothly and will enter mass production as expected. By Q4 2026, AI ASIC chip business could generate approximately $20 billion in revenue, far exceeding the previous estimate of $10 billion. MediaTek has raised its estimate of the total addressable market for data center ASICs to $70-80 billion by 2027, targeting a 10-15% market share. This represents significant growth potential for Taiwan's semiconductor sector.

high.title: Goldman Sachs Raises MediaTek Target Price to NT$5,000, Reaffirms "Buy" Rating
high.summary: Goldman Sachs dramatically increased MediaTek's target price by 103% from NT$2,454 to NT$5,000, the highest among foreign brokerages, citing the AI ASIC upcycle that has just begun with significant profit potential through 2028. This marks Goldman's third target price increase this year, jumping from NT$1,400 initially. The firm raised MediaTek's 2028 AI ASIC revenue estimate from $19 billion to $48 billion, expecting it to account for 66% of total revenue. Goldman projects 2028 EPS at NT$406.51, up from NT$177.38 previously, applying a 25x P/E ratio. The upgrade reflects strong confidence in MediaTek's AI ASIC business trajectory and represents nearly 92% upside potential from the April 30 closing price of NT$2,610.

high.title: U.S. Tech Giants Report Strong Results, Creating Opportunities for TSMC, Hon Hai, Quanta
high.summary: Major U.S. tech companies including Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Alphabet have delivered strong earnings results exceeding expectations, with combined capital expenditure raised to $670 billion this year. This positive momentum is expected to benefit Taiwan's supply chain partners including TSMC (2330), Hon Hai, and Quanta. TSMC, as the foundry partner for major U.S. firms and leader in Taiwan's market rally, remains a focal point with analysts setting aggressive targets - Lyon Securities and local broker Mega Securities both targeting NT$3,000, with 21 brokerages giving targets above NT$2,500. The strong U.S. tech earnings season validates the AI investment cycle and reinforces Taiwan's critical position in the global semiconductor supply chain.

medium.title: Taiwan Cement Celebrates 80th Anniversary, Launches World's Strongest 10,000-Pound Cement for Semiconductor and AI Data Center Construction
medium.summary: Taiwan Cement (1101) launched the world's strongest 10,000-pound strength cement targeting semiconductor and AI data center construction boom. Chairman Chang An-ping expressed hope to begin construction on the NT$26.8 billion Keelung Road development project this year. The company is positioning itself for the next phase of civilization development with focus on infrastructure supporting AI and high-tech manufacturing.

medium.title: Taiwan Stock Market Sunny Outlook with Four Hot Themes, Analysts See Index Reaching 42,500-44,000 Points
medium.summary: Major brokerages predict Taiwan stocks could reach 42,500-44,000 points on four positive catalysts: strong April revenue from AI supply chain companies, robust Q1 earnings potentially exceeding NT$1.5 trillion, upgraded capex from four major CSPs to $670 billion, and COMPUTEX warm-up momentum with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's keynote on June 1st. However, concerns include record-high margin lending and upcoming tax season.

medium.title: Hon Hai Low-Earth Orbit Satellite Reports Success
medium.summary: Hon Hai's (2317) second-generation LEO satellites "PEARL-1A" and "PEARL-1B" successfully launched via SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, entering planned orbit. The 6U XL designed satellites will conduct inter-satellite communication experiments using Ka-band inter-satellite links, advancing Hon Hai's position in the LEO satellite communication sector alongside its AI infrastructure business expansion.

medium.title: Container Shipping Rates Set for Two Waves of Increases in May, Benefiting Evergreen, Yang Ming, Wan Hai
medium.summary: May container shipping rates expected to rise in two waves due to high oil costs from U.S.-Iran war, reduced global capacity, and early ordering by manufacturers. Trans-Pacific rates already confirmed increases early May, with second wave expected mid-May after China's May Day holiday. This should boost revenue for major Taiwan shipping companies Evergreen (2603), Yang Ming (2609), and Wan Hai (2615).
